ai-chat-widget.title: Launcher and window placement (V1 to V3)
ai-chat-widget.description: Vectoria AI chat launcher shown in three placements over an Insights dashboard, with a V1–V3 switcher for icon and window position.

ai-chat-widget/surfaces/training-plan.ht.title: FAB surface: Training Plan
ai-chat-widget/surfaces/training-plan.ht.description: Learner training-plan page with the Fin chat FAB, count tiles, and Overdue and Due soon sections with Resume/Start actions.

ai-chat-widget/surfaces/catalog.html.title: FAB surface: Catalog
ai-chat-widget/surfaces/catalog.html.description: Course catalog page hosting the Fin chat FAB, with search, category filter chips, course cards, and a grid/list view toggle.

assigned-training-wizard.title: Assigned Training Wizard
assigned-training-wizard.description: Full-page assign-training wizard with a five-step stepper: Select Training, Assignees, Scheduling, Optional Settings, and Review.

component-redesigns.html.title: Component Redesigns
component-redesigns.html.description: Interactive gallery of EHS LMS component redesign options comparing nav-item, launch-button, and card-tile variants.

Qualification-Builder/Manage-Qualificati.title: Manage Qualifications
Qualification-Builder/Manage-Qualificati.description: AG Grid list of qualifications with Build with AI or Create manually entry points and deactivate/delete row actions.

Qualification-Builder/Manage-Requirement.title: Manage Requirements
Qualification-Builder/Manage-Requirement.description: AG Grid list of requirements with sortable columns; row names link into the AI or manual requirement builders.

Qualification-Builder/Manage-Activities..title: Manage Activities
Qualification-Builder/Manage-Activities..description: AG Grid list of learning activities feeding qualifications, with links into Edit Activity or Learning Studio.

Qualification-Builder/Edit-Activity.html.title: Edit Activity
Qualification-Builder/Edit-Activity.html.description: Activity editor split into Details, Delivery, Attributes, and Attachments tabs, including version history and recomplete settings.

Qualification-Builder/AI-Qualification-B.title: AI Qualification Builder
Qualification-Builder/AI-Qualification-B.description: Qualification builder pairing a program canvas — Requirements, Activities, Settings — with a conversational AI assistant panel.

Qualification-Builder/AI-Qualification-B.title: AI Qualification Builder V2
Qualification-Builder/AI-Qualification-B.description: Guided AI assistant: four questions with in-thread option chips ending in Other, live canvas building, strict field mapping, no confirm step.

Qualification-Builder/AI-Qualification-B.title: AI Qualification Builder V3
Qualification-Builder/AI-Qualification-B.description: V2 guided flow restyled with the purple AI treatment from the scheduling rules builder, an AI Assistant header, and a start-over control.

Qualification-Builder/Manual-Qualificati.title: Manual Qualification Builder
Qualification-Builder/Manual-Qualificati.description: Manual variant of the qualification builder without the AI panel, adding existing requirements and activities directly.

Qualification-Builder/AI-Requirement-Bui.title: AI Requirement Builder
Qualification-Builder/AI-Requirement-Bui.description: Requirement builder pairing an activities canvas with an AI assistant panel that drafts requirements from prompts.

Qualification-Builder/Manual-Requirement.title: Manual Requirement Builder
Qualification-Builder/Manual-Requirement.description: Manual requirement builder defining a requirement by picking activities, with sharing and an audit history.

Convergence Small UI Improvements.title: All six areas (start here)
Convergence Small UI Improvements.description: Every area in one navigable file: home dashboard, side nav, top-nav location picker, training plan list and cards, catalog table and the content wizard, plus the shared token reference.

Convergence Small UI Improvements/ver1/h.title: Area 7: Home dashboard
Convergence Small UI Improvements/ver1/h.description: Legacy Home page restyled: one ring geometry for all three progress stats, a neutral empty state instead of the red error block, and card footers that cannot overlap content.

Convergence Small UI Improvements/ver1/d.title: Areas 1 + 2: Chrome and side nav
Convergence Small UI Improvements/ver1/d.description: Redesigned side nav (one selection language, no dividers, collapsible rail) and the location picker moved into the top nav, with the shared token set laid out.

Convergence Small UI Improvements/ver1/t.title: Areas 3 + 4: Training plan
Convergence Small UI Improvements/ver1/t.description: Accordion list, both card densities, the session-selection banner, and drill-in detail pages for qualifications, requirements and activities (?details=act:a4 deep links).

Convergence Small UI Improvements/ver1/c.title: Area 5: Catalog (cards + table)
Convergence Small UI Improvements/ver1/c.description: Category modules with circular prev/next arrows, cards matching the Training Plan card component (E tags, Assigned badges), and View all opening the table per category.

Convergence Small UI Improvements/ver1/c.title: Area 6: Content Wizard
Convergence Small UI Improvements/ver1/c.description: All four wizard steps in one centred panel: labelled stepper, equal selectable tiles with real selected states, and standardised footer controls.

location-nav.title: Location Navigation
location-nav.description: Administration Dashboard with a redesigned location switcher opening a clickable location tree and a 'Now viewing' indicator.

Mobile App.title: Mobile App
Mobile App.description: Mobile app prototype in a phone frame spanning 17 screens, from org lookup and sign-in to learner home, training, and quizzes.

Report Redesigns/Report Redesign/V1/V1 S.title: Report Redesign V1 (Scheduling)
Report Redesigns/Report Redesign/V1/V1 S.description: Qualification Reporting redesign (v1) as report cards with date presets, entity pickers, chart toggles, and delivery scheduling.

Report Redesigns/Report Redesign/V2 With.title: Report Redesign V2 (Management Pages)
Report Redesigns/Report Redesign/V2 With.description: Reporting redesign (v2) extending v1 with CRUD management pages for saved views and scheduled reports.

Report Redesigns/Tasklist Report.title: Tasklist Report
Report Redesigns/Tasklist Report.description: Insights Tasklist Report tracking task sign-offs in a filterable table of instructor and employee sign-off and comments.

Report Redesigns/Table Breakpoints.title: Table Breakpoints Reference
Report Redesigns/Table Breakpoints.description: Reference documenting report-table behavior across seven responsive breakpoints, with an interactive simulator and column spec.

select-qualifications-modal.title: Select Qualifications Modal
select-qualifications-modal.description: Sizing spec previewing the Select Qualifications modal at four breakpoints from large desktop to mobile.
